completion_criteria.text: Authoritative spec authored and adversarially reviewed before implementation
Implementation committed to feat/centralized-pr-creation with engine and hook suites green
permissions.deny covers the Bash and GitHub MCP PR-write surface; permissions.allow verified untouched
Gate demonstrably blocks raw PR creation at runtime, with merge denials preserved

New PR path verified LIVE end to end AND every old PR-creation implementation verified removed (no residual --body-line, no mitosis: title prefix, no duplicate sanitizer at the old mitosis.js site, no caller still on the old CLI surface)
GitHub MCP authenticated and the eight deny tool names pinned against the live tool list

spine.active_goal: Land centralized PR creation (one tool, one gate, one rule), prove the new path is live with every old implementation removed, and close the GitHub MCP leg by pinning its deny names against the live tool list.
spine.next_step: THREE ITEMS, in order. (1) `git status --short .zshrc` must be EMPTY; else `git checkout -- .zshrc` - tracked, pushed, may hold a burned PAT. (2) /mcp must show github CONNECTED; if not, confirm the launch was FROM A TERMINAL (Dock never sources .zshrc), then suspect ${VAR} expansion unsupported at user scope - fallback is a project .mcp.json, same placeholder. (3) Enumerate live github tools, reconcile vs the 8 denied in settings.json, hunting PR-writers NOT denied. Only then consider done.
open_risks: The 8 GitHub MCP deny names are still unverified guesses; that path stays probably-but-not-provably closed until the live tool list is read post-restart.

${VAR} expansion in MCP config is documented for .mcp.json but UNCONFIRMED for user-scope ~/.claude.json; if auth fails after restart this is the first suspect, and the fallback is a project .mcp.json.
~/.zshrc is a symlink to <repo>/.zshrc, which is TRACKED and pushed. If the checkout was not run it still carries a burned PAT. Never let a credential reach it or anything under ~/.claude.

The gate is a text matcher: it blocks benign commands that merely mention a blocked phrase (observed firsthand this session), and cannot close subprocess indirection. Accepted, documented, not to be re-litigated.
The harness emits a FALSE-POSITIVE self-modification warning on gate work that adds deny entries. Verify direction by direct read before reacting.

Branch is 7 commits unpushed, and the tree carries three unrelated items (.drift-state.json, no-self-merge-consent.test.mjs, untracked .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) that must NOT be swept into commits.
out_of_scope: Auto-assigning PR reviewers - reviewers are chosen manually.
Merging PRs - always human, never Claude, under any origin.
Editing vendored plugin code - the origin-agnostic gate covers it instead.
Pushing the branch or opening a PR for this work.
